metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 30 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ECMWF ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) for 2m air temperature over a 10 km buffer around Boston, MA, for 2019-01-29 to 2019-02-06 (end exclusive). Fallback to ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY if empty.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for reanalysis; ensure valid pixel counts via Reducer.count.
3. Logic: Compute daily maximum temperature (Celsius) per day, reduce over region, get min/max of these daily highs, compute difference. Validate counts and value ranges; handle empty/no valid pixels and nulls.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const bostonPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.0589, 42.3601]);
    const geom = bostonPt.buffer(10000); // ~10 km buffer around Boston center
    const start = '2019-01-29';
    const end = '2019-02-06'; // end exclusive to include Feb 5

    // Helper to getInfo as a Promise
    const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .select(['temperature_2m']);
    let size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select(['temperature_2m']);
      size = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log(`Hourly Images (${dataset}): 0`);
        console.log('Days: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }
    console.log(`Hourly Images (${dataset}): ${size}`);

    // 3. Processing: Convert to Celsius and build daily maximum images
    const colC = col.map(img => {
      const tC = img.select('temperature_2m').subtract(273.15).rename('t2mC');
      const day = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd');
      return tC.set('day', day);
    });

    const days = ee.List(colC.aggregate_array('day')).distinct().sort();
    const dailyCol = ee.ImageCollection(days.map(function(d) {
      d = ee.String(d);
      const dayCol = colC.filter(ee.Filter.eq('day', d));
      const dailyMax = dayCol.max().set('day', d)
        .set('system:time_start', ee.Date.parse('YYYY-MM-dd', d).millis());
      return dailyMax;
    }));

    const nDays = await getInfo(dailyCol.size());
    console.log(`Days: ${nDays}`);

    // 4. Summarize per day: mean and pixel count within region
    const dailySummary = dailyCol.map(function(img) {
      const stats = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const meanC = stats.get('t2mC_mean');
      const count = stats.get('t2mC_count');
      return ee.Feature(null, {
        day: img.get('day'),
        meanC: meanC,
        count: count
      });
    });
    const dailyInfo = await getInfo(dailySummary);

    // 5. Validate counts and values, compute min/max difference
    const validDays = [];
    let anyInvalidValue = false;
    (dailyInfo.features || []).forEach(f => {
      const props = f.properties || {};
      const d = props.day;
      const meanC = props.meanC;
      const count = props.count || 0;
      const meanStr = (meanC === null || meanC === undefined) ? 'null' : meanC.toFixed(2);
      console.log(`${d}: maxC=${meanStr}°C, pixels=${count}`);
      if (count > 0 && meanC !== null && meanC !== undefined && isFinite(meanC)) {
        // sanity check plausible range for 2m air temperature
        if (meanC < -100 || meanC > 60) {
          anyInvalidValue = true;
        } else {
          validDays.push(meanC);
        }
      }
    });

    if ((dailyInfo.features || []).length === 0) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    if (validDays.length === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (anyInvalidValue) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Compute min, max, diff among daily highs
    const minDailyMax = Math.min.apply(null, validDays);
    const maxDailyMax = Math.max.apply(null, validDays);
    const diff = maxDailyMax - minDailyMax;

    console.log(`MinDailyMaxC: ${minDailyMax.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`MaxDailyMaxC: ${maxDailyMax.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`DiffC: ${diff.toFixed(2)}`);

    // 6. Final Answer: Was there at least a 30°C difference?
    if (!isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (diff >= 30.0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
